title: SEECertificateExtractionSchema
description: Schema for structured data extraction for the Secondary Education Examination (SEE) Certificate. Labels presented in English, all field values verbatim from the printed source (original script if printed in Devanagari).

sr_no.description: Serial Number (SR NO) at the upper right; exactly as printed.

emblem_placeholder.description: Always 'Coat of Arms of Nepal'. Placeholder for top-left national emblem.

board_logo_placeholder.description: Always 'NEB Board Logo'. Placeholder for top-right NEB logo.

certificate_title_np.description: Certificate heading in Nepali (प्रमाण–पत्र), center top.

certificate_title_en.description: Certificate heading in English (Certificate), center top below Nepali title.

student_name.description: Full name of the student, as printed after 'This is to certify that'.

school_name.description: School name following 'a student of'. Extract in full.

examination_year_bs.description: Examination completion year in Bikram Samvat (e.g., 2079 BS).

examination_year_ad.description: Examination completion year in AD (e.g., 2023 AD).

gpa.description: Grade Point Average (GPA), extracted as printed (decimal value).

date_of_birth_bs.description: Student's date of birth in Bikram Samvat (BS), as printed.

date_of_birth_ad.description: Student's date of birth in AD, as printed.

symbol_no.description: Symbol Number, as printed near certificate bottom left above date of issue.

date_of_issue.description: Date of issue, as printed in English, e.g. 24-July-2023.

checked_by.description: Office and location that performed the check (footer left).

footer_line.description: Bottom border line before footer. Use '---' to signal layout line.

signature_name.description: Printed signatory name below signature placeholder, e.g. Bishnu Narayan Shrestha.

signature_title.description: Signature block title, e.g. CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS.

seal_placeholder.description: Always 'Round Office Seal'. Placeholder for the round black/red official stamp/seal.
